q1: SELECT CLASS FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(*)>=5
q2: WITH CLASS_CT (CLASS, STUDENT_CT) AS ( SELECT CLASS, COUNT(CLASS) AS STUDENT_CT FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS ) SELECT CLASS FROM CLASS_CT WHERE STUDENT_CT >= 5
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT CLASS FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(*)>=5
q2_prompt_sql: WITH CLASS_CT (CLASS, STUDENT_CT) AS ( SELECT CLASS, COUNT(CLASS) AS STUDENT_CT FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS ) SELECT CLASS FROM CLASS_CT WHERE STUDENT_CT >= 5
explanation: Both queries aim to find classes that have at least 5 students enrolled. Q1 directly groups by CLASS and filters with HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5, while Q2 uses a CTE to achieve the same result by first counting students per CLASS and then filtering on the count.
